title: ApiUsageEvent
description: Emitted after every external API / LLM call. Enables cost tracking and quota enforcement.

agent_id.description: Agent that made the API call.

execution_id.description: Links this usage event to the parent ExecutionEvent.

provider.description: API provider identifier (e.g. openai, anthropic, aws, google, cursor).

token_type.description: MUST always be 'service_account'. User credentials are strictly prohibited by policy.

tokens_used.description: Total tokens consumed (prompt + completion for LLM calls).

estimated_cost_usd.description: Estimated cost in USD. Computed by the SDK based on provider pricing at call time.

model.description: Optional: specific model version used (e.g. gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-6).
